meta_description:
514 likes, 11 comments - techhelpindia on October 1, 2026: "Had an unforgettable time at the ASUS Community Event in Lucknow 💻⚡

Got to explore the latest ASUS lineup hands-on — the Zenbook Duo’s dual-screen experience genuinely blew my mind, spent way more time with it than I planned to.
Watched the team walk us through their latest innovations, saw fellow creators demo some incredible laptops for design, gaming and editing workflows.

And the best part? Got to host a live Q&A with the audience — their energy made the whole segment so much fun.
Definitely a memorable day surrounded by great tech and an even better community. ✨

Thank you, @asusindia for having me! 🤝
.
.
.
#ASUS #ASUSIndia #BeyondIncrediblewithASUS #ZenbookDuo #CommunityEvent".
